sources.note: both sides import the same working-tree lib/ modules; only lib/diagnostics.js differs, and it is the only file this change edits

method.wallAndCpu: one collectDiagnostics() call in a fresh child process per sample; median over the rounds
method.peakRss: process.resourceUsage().maxRSS of a fresh child process that ran collectDiagnostics() once (includes process startup)
method.allocation: V8 HeapProfiler sampling, interval 32768 bytes, includes GC-collected objects, per call
method.bytes: whole-file readFileSync calls on the scenario *.jsonl files are counted per side; the fixture byte total is what the summary loop scans on either side
method.equality: sha256 of the whole report with generatedAt removed; identical across all sides and pairings
method.aa: A/A runs the same baseline module twice; its delta is the noise floor
